description: This file defines the 'Radios' class, a Drupal form element for rendering a set of radio buttons, including methods for processing options and handling default values.

classes.name: Radios
classes.description: A Drupal form element class for rendering radio button sets, with methods for processing options and managing default values.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration info for the radios form element, including processing and theming.

methods.name: processRadios
methods.description: Expands a radios element into individual radio button elements with proper attributes and unique IDs.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Handles the retrieval and validation of the radio button's value based on user input or default.
